name: Ranasarima
source:
Dragon Adventurer

Rana is a fullblooded Dragon and relatively strong for her age... but even so, her parents refused to allow her to leave home without her much more levelheaded younger brother tagging along to keep her out of trouble.
Together, the two siblings have traveled all over the region in pursuit of adventure, the latest of which has led them to the Kingdom of Marconetti.

Though her tendency to never think things through and total lack of a sense of direction are an eternal source of aggravation for her brother, even he will admit that her cheerful disposition and eagerness to help others makes up for those flaws.

Not that she sees herself as anything less than perfect.
